def ir(kind, params, givens=(), vars_=None, shape="set", dod=None):

         "givens": list(givens), "answer_shape": shape}
    if dod:
        d["domain_of_discourse"] = dod
    return d


def sol(payload, kind="set"):
    return {"claimed_answer": {"kind": kind, "payload": payload}, "steps": []}


def show(label, i, s):
    r = verify(i, s)
    steps = [(x["id"], x["status"]) for l in r.layers if l.layer == "steps.refute" for x in (l.evidence or {}).get("steps", [])]
    print(f"{r.verdict:9s} | {label} | steps={steps}")

expected: x positive iken 1/x'in ilkeli olarak log(−x) (x>0'da gerçel değil) INCORRECT/UNKNOWN; x>0 kısıtında |x| için x²/2 CORRECT; verilen x<0 kısıtla aynı karar.
actual_now: x positive: 1/x → log(−x) CORRECT; kısıt x>0: |x| → x²/2 INCORRECT; verilen x<0: 1/x → log(−x) INCORRECT (kısıt x<0 ile CORRECT).
math_reason: x>0'da log(−x) = log x + iπ, gerçel değil (mpmath: log(−1) = iπ); x>0'da (x²/2)' = x = |x|.
root_cause: calculus.verify antiderivative: discourse=ctx.domain_for (verilenleri okumaz: antiderivative _MAIN_RELATION'da yok); positive sembol iddianın yazılı koşulunu (−x>0) False'a katlıyor ve denetim düşüyor; kısıtlı alanda |x| karşılaştırması alan dışını da sayıyor [mekanizmanın son kısmı DOĞRULANMADI].
variants: 1/x (positive, kısıt, verilen, dod), |x| (kısıt x>0, verilen x<0, negative_real).
repro:
from mathverify.verifier import verify


def ir(kind, params, givens=(), vars_=None, shape="set", dod=None):
    d = {"task": {"kind": kind, "params": params}, "vars": vars_ or [{"name": "x", "domain": "real"}],
         "givens": list(givens), "answer_shape": shape}
    if dod:
        d["domain_of_discourse"] = dod
    return d


def sol(payload, kind="set"):
    return {"claimed_answer": {"kind": kind, "payload": payload}, "steps": []}


def show(label, i, s):
    r = verify(i, s)
    steps = [(x["id"], x["status"]) for l in r.layers if l.layer == "steps.refute" for x in (l.evidence or {}).get("steps", [])]
    print(f"{r.verdict:9s} | {label} | steps={steps}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    show("antiderivative of 1/x, x positive, claim log(-x) [not real for x > 0]",
         ir("antiderivative", {"integrand": "1/x", "var": "x"}, vars_=[{"name": "x", "domain": "positive_real"}], shape="expression"),
         sol("log(-x)", "expression"))
    show("antiderivative of |x| with constraint x > 0, claim x**2/2 [right]",
         ir("antiderivative", {"integrand": "Abs(x)", "var": "x"}, vars_=[{"name": "x", "domain": "real", "constraints": ["x > 0"]}],
            shape="expression"), sol("x**2/2", "expression"))
    show("antiderivative of 1/x with given x < 0, claim log(-x) [right]",
         ir("antiderivative", {"integrand": "1/x", "var": "x"}, ["x < 0"], shape="expression"), sol("log(-x)", "expression"))
    show("antiderivative of 1/x with constraint x < 0, claim log(-x) (control)",
         ir("antiderivative", {"integrand": "1/x", "var": "x"}, vars_=[{"name": "x", "domain": "real", "constraints": ["x < 0"]}],
            shape="expression"), sol("log(-x)", "expression"))
